answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement, so a regional shift is the only candidate that can restore availability while still accepting customer writes. Rollback is blocked by the non-revertible security patch. Circuit breaking would shed writes, which violates the objective. Read-replica routing historically offloaded dashboards, not the write path. Capacity headroom helped when provisioned before a peak; we are already in the peak, so it is a weaker match. Verifying the failover and pre-peak capacity archives before committing. Peak settlement means a full cutover has downstream value risk, so keep this a standard-scale shift rather than a broad untested rollout. Root cause still uncertain (release timing vs regional saturation).
